data.exact_reserve_text: There have been adverse movements on all underwriting years, apart from on 2007 where a release of claims reserves has resulted in an underwriting profit of GBP 8.3m on that year.  However, the uncertainty over the ultimate cost of Italian Public Hospitals claims has reduced and a reserve release on the 2007 and prior years of account has resulted in an operating profit of GBP 8,334k for the financial year.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at the opening of the year were GBP 549.509m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows net adverse development in prior years (2011-2013 and earlier individual years) resulting in a gross strengthening of reserves of approximately GBP 107.1m (19.5% of opening reserves). Separately, the syndicate recorded a release of reserves relating to Italian Public Hospital medical malpractice (2007 and prior), which produced an operating profit of GBP 8.334m; however, on aggregate the prior-year movement was adverse driven by deterioration in multiple older underwriting years.
raw_causal_phrases: There have been adverse movements on all underwriting years, apart from on 2007 where a release of claims reserves has resulted in an underwriting profit of GBP 8.3m on that year.

However, the uncertainty over the ultimate cost of Italian Public Hospitals claims has reduced and a reserve release on the 2007 and prior years of account has resulted in an operating profit of GBP 8,334k for the financial year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross presentation, units in GBP 000). The triangle contains an aggregate 'Before 2011' column which was excluded from the diagonal comparison per instructions. The 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting years' line in the P&L was NOT used (it is an income-statement incurred claims figure, not the prior-year reserve movement). The Italian Public Hospitals reserve release is stated in narrative as producing an GBP 8,334k operating profit (treated here as a release). No RITC or other distortion was identified in the notes that would invalidate the triangle calculation.
